comments.author: @19irving
comments.text:
I grew up on LI and lived there for 33 years. Many of my 20 cousins are still there.

What makes LI unique isn't in this video. It's the way the Island was mass settled by returning GIs with zero down mortgages who wanted to escape the NYC ghettos and tenements of their often immigrant parents.

This created a unique, somewhat cut off culture that is largely Italian, Irish and Jewish that developed certain values (I'm Italian and Irish and married a Jew).

If you want to understand more, please read Home Fires: An Intimate Portrait of One Middle-Class Family in Postwar America. It is a work of nonfiction by journalist and author Donald Katz (published in 1992 by HarperCollins).
